name: clinc_oos
description: CLINC150 assistant intents with a genuine out-of-scope class, 150 in-scope options plus none_of_the_above. The only public set that tests the escape option directly.

intent.instructions: This is a single utterance spoken to a general-purpose voice assistant. Which one of the following intents is the user expressing? Choose "none_of_the_above" if the utterance is outside everything this assistant handles, which happens often: many users ask for things the assistant was never built to do.

criteria.restaurant_reviews: What reviews or ratings say about a named restaurant.
criteria.nutrition_info: The nutritional content or healthiness of a food, beyond just its calorie count.
criteria.account_blocked: The account is already frozen, barred or on hold and the user wants to know why they cannot get at it. The block exists and they did not ask for it.
criteria.oil_change_how: The procedure for changing the oil: what to do, or what is needed. A how question.
criteria.time: What the current clock time is, optionally somewhere else.
criteria.weather: The weather or temperature, now or in the forecast.
criteria.redeem_rewards: Cashing in, spending or using credit card reward points.
criteria.interest_rate: The interest rate paid or charged on a bank account such as checking or savings. Not a credit card rate, which is apr.
criteria.gas_type: Which grade or kind of fuel the car takes.
criteria.accept_reservations: Whether a named restaurant takes reservations at all. A question about the restaurant's policy, not a booking.
criteria.smart_home: Controlling a connected device around the home or car, such as thermostat, air conditioning or remote start.
criteria.user_name: Asking what the assistant currently calls the user. Reading the name, not setting it.
criteria.report_lost_card: Reporting a card as lost or stolen so it can be cancelled.
criteria.repeat: The user did not hear and wants the last thing said again.
criteria.whisper_mode: Switching to whisper mode or asking the assistant to speak softly.
criteria.what_are_your_hobbies: What the assistant does for fun or in its spare time.
criteria.order: Buying or reordering goods, such as restocking something the user has run out of.
criteria.jump_start: How to jump start a car with a dead battery.
criteria.schedule_meeting: Creating a new meeting, or asking how to create one.
criteria.meeting_schedule: Reading back what meetings are already on the schedule.
criteria.freeze_account: The user is asking the bank to put a stop, hold or freeze on their account. A request they are making now, not an existing block they are complaining about.
criteria.what_song: Identifying the song that is currently playing.
criteria.meaning_of_life: The philosophical question of what life is for.
criteria.restaurant_reservation: Booking a new table at a restaurant.
criteria.traffic: How heavy traffic is on a route or at a time.
criteria.make_call: Placing a phone call to a named person.
criteria.text: Sending a text message to someone.
criteria.bill_balance: How much is owed on a specific bill from a named provider such as a phone, cable or electricity company. The amount owed to a third party, not money held at the bank.
criteria.improve_credit_score: How to build, protect or repair credit, or what actions would harm it. Advice about the future, not a lookup of the current score.
criteria.change_language: Switching the language the conversation is conducted in.
criteria.no: A negative answer, disagreement, or a statement that something is wrong.
criteria.measurement_conversion: Converting between units of measurement such as inches, centimetres or pounds.
criteria.timer: Setting a countdown timer for a duration such as ten minutes.
criteria.do_you_have_pets: Whether the assistant has pets, and what they are.
criteria.balance: How much money is currently in a bank account. A plain balance lookup, not a bill and not reward points.
criteria.tell_joke: A request for a joke or something funny.
criteria.last_maintenance: When the car was last serviced or had its oil changed. A fact about the past.
criteria.exchange_rate: The conversion rate between two currencies.
criteria.uber: Ordering a rideshare or taxi to a destination.
criteria.car_rental: Renting a car, or where a car can be rented.
criteria.credit_limit: What the current spending limit on a card is. A lookup of an existing number.
criteria.shopping_list: Reading back what is on the shopping list.
criteria.routing: The bank routing number for an account.
criteria.meal_suggestion: Asking what dish or cuisine to eat or make, with no restaurant involved.
criteria.tire_change: When tires should be replaced, given when they were last replaced.
criteria.todo_list: Reading back what is on the to-do or task list.
criteria.card_declined: Why a card was refused at a specific purchase that already happened.
criteria.rewards_balance: How many reward points the user has accumulated. A lookup of a points total.
criteria.change_accent: Switching the assistant's voice or accent, such as to a male or British voice.
criteria.vaccines: Which vaccinations or shots are needed to travel somewhere.
criteria.reminder_update: Creating, changing or deleting a reminder. A write to the list.
criteria.food_last: How long food stays good, or when it will spoil or expire.
criteria.change_ai_name: Giving the assistant a different name or nickname.
criteria.bill_due: The date a specific bill, loan or insurance payment is next due.
criteria.who_do_you_work_for: Who employs the assistant or who its boss is.
criteria.share_location: Sending the user's location to another person.
criteria.international_visa: Whether a travel visa is needed for a country.
criteria.calendar: Reading the calendar: what is on it, or whether some event is on it.
criteria.translate: Rendering a word or phrase into another language.
criteria.carry_on: Airline carry-on baggage rules, limits and allowances.
criteria.book_flight: Booking a flight between named places or dates.
criteria.insurance_change: Switching to a different insurance plan, or starting a new one.
criteria.todo_list_update: Adding to, clearing or removing from the to-do list.
criteria.timezone: Which time zone a named place is in. The zone itself, not the current time.
criteria.cancel_reservation: Cancelling or getting rid of a restaurant reservation that already exists.
criteria.transactions: A list or lookup of individual recent purchases on the account, such as the last five, or the most recent one.
criteria.credit_score: What the user's current credit score or rating is. A lookup of an existing number.
criteria.report_fraud: Reporting fraudulent or unauthorised activity on an account or card. The card is not necessarily missing; the complaint is about charges the user did not make.
criteria.spending_history: How much the user spent over some past period, or at some named merchant. An aggregate over time, not a list of individual purchases.
criteria.directions: How to get to a place, or where the nearest one is.
criteria.spelling: How a word is spelled, or how many of a letter it contains.
criteria.insurance: What the user's existing insurance or health plan covers or provides.
criteria.reminder: Reading back the existing reminders. What is on the list.
criteria.where_are_you_from: Where the assistant comes from or was born.
criteria.distance: How far away a place is, or how long it takes to reach it.
criteria.payday: When the user next gets paid, or when they last were.
criteria.flight_status: Whether a flight is on time, or when it lands. Status of a flight that exists.
criteria.find_phone: The user has misplaced their phone and wants help locating it.
criteria.greeting: The user is opening the conversation or saying hello.
criteria.alarm: Setting an alarm for a clock time, typically to wake up or be alerted at that time.
criteria.order_status: Tracking a package or checking where an existing order has got to.
criteria.confirm_reservation: Confirming or verifying a reservation that already exists, usually naming a time and a name.
criteria.cook_time: How long something needs to cook, bake or simmer. A duration.
criteria.damaged_card: The physical card is broken, scratched, shredded or chewed up, and needs replacing. The card is present but unusable.
criteria.reset_settings: Returning the assistant or device to its default or factory settings.
criteria.pin_change: Changing, resetting or obtaining a new PIN number.
criteria.replacement_card_duration: How long a replacement card will take to arrive. A question about elapsed time.
criteria.new_card: How to obtain or apply for a card the user does not have yet. A first card, not a replacement for one they lost.
criteria.roll_dice: Rolling dice, sometimes with a named number of sides.
criteria.taxes: What the user owes in tax or will get back.
criteria.date: What today's date is, or what the date will be some number of days out.
criteria.who_made_you: Who built or created the assistant.
criteria.pto_request: Making a new request for time off, or asking how to make one.
criteria.tire_pressure: The current pressure in the car's tires.
criteria.how_old_are_you: The user asks the assistant its own age or when it was created.
criteria.rollover_401k: Moving or rolling over a 401k retirement account, usually after changing jobs.
criteria.pto_request_status: Whether a time-off request already submitted has been approved yet.
criteria.how_busy: How crowded a place is or how long the wait will be, usually at a named time.
criteria.application_status: Whether a credit card or account application the user already submitted has been approved, processed or gone through yet.
criteria.recipe: A request for a recipe or for how to cook a named dish. The method, not the ingredient list alone.
criteria.calendar_update: Changing the calendar by adding or removing an event.
criteria.play_music: Starting music playing, whether a song, artist or playlist.
criteria.direct_deposit: Setting up direct deposit of a paycheck into an account.
criteria.credit_limit_change: A request to raise, lower or otherwise alter the credit limit. A change, not a lookup.
criteria.gas: How much fuel is left in the tank right now.
criteria.pay_bill: An instruction to actually make a payment now, rather than to look up an amount or a date.
criteria.ingredients_list: What ingredients a dish contains or what is needed to make it. The list of items, not the method.
criteria.lost_luggage: Luggage went missing on a flight and the user is reporting or chasing it.
criteria.goodbye: The user is ending the conversation.
criteria.what_can_i_ask_you: What the assistant is able to help with, or what kinds of questions it takes.
criteria.book_hotel: Booking or finding a place to stay.
criteria.are_you_a_bot: Whether the assistant is a machine or a person.
criteria.next_song: Skipping forward to the next track.
criteria.change_speed: Making the assistant talk faster or slower.
criteria.plug_type: Which electrical plug, socket or adapter a country uses.
criteria.maybe: A hedged or uncertain answer: possibly, not sure, could be either.
criteria.oil_change_when: When the next oil change is due or how often one is needed. A when question.
criteria.thank_you: The user is thanking the assistant.
criteria.shopping_list_update: Adding to or removing from the shopping list.
criteria.pto_balance: How much paid time off the user has left or accrued.
criteria.order_checks: Ordering more paper checks or checkbooks to be mailed out.
criteria.travel_alert: Whether a destination is safe, or has a warning or advisory against it.
criteria.fun_fact: A piece of trivia or an interesting fact about a named thing.
criteria.sync_device: Pairing, connecting or disconnecting a device such as a phone.
criteria.schedule_maintenance: Booking a future service, inspection or repair appointment for the car.
criteria.apr: The annual percentage rate or interest rate charged on a credit card.
criteria.transfer: Moving money between accounts, whether the user's own or someone else's.
criteria.ingredient_substitution: Whether one ingredient can be used in place of another.
criteria.calories: How many calories are in a food or dish.
criteria.current_location: Where the user is right now.
criteria.international_fees: What it costs to use the card abroad, including foreign ATM and transaction fees.
criteria.calculator: An arithmetic calculation: a percentage, sum, product or fraction.
criteria.next_holiday: When the next public holiday or day off falls.
criteria.update_playlist: Adding a song to a playlist or otherwise editing a playlist's contents.
criteria.mpg: The car's fuel economy in miles per gallon.
criteria.min_payment: The smallest amount the user is allowed to pay on a bill this cycle.
criteria.change_user_name: Telling the assistant what to call the user from now on. Setting the name.
criteria.restaurant_suggestion: Asking which restaurant or place to eat at, usually in a named area.
criteria.travel_notification: Telling the bank about upcoming travel so the card is not blocked abroad.
criteria.cancel: Stop or abandon what is currently happening. An instruction to halt, not an answer to a question.
criteria.pto_used: How much paid time off the user has already taken.
criteria.travel_suggestion: What to do, see or visit at a destination.
criteria.change_volume: Making the assistant louder or quieter, or setting a volume level.
criteria.none_of_the_above: The utterance is out of scope. It is a reasonable thing for a person to say, and it may even be phrased like a normal assistant request, but it is not one of the other intents on this list. Choose this rather than forcing the closest-sounding intent: the request is for a capability the assistant does not have, a topic it does not cover, or information it cannot hold.
